en.html:
In this sealed space, darkness only. And darkness it remained. Not the smallest sign of change. Time must have sat down here and decided it was not getting up.

Everything the same.
The same moment, again and again.

Darkness, still darkness.
The shackles on my limbs, still fixed.
And my heartsteel—my heart—rotting. That alone had found something to do, and would not stop.

ja.html:
閉ざされた空間に有るのは暗闇だけで、それはいつ
までも闇のまま、何の変化の兆しもなかった。
　きっとここでは、時間が動いていないのだろう。

　何もかも、ずっと同じ。
　同一の瞬間の繰り返し。

　闇は闇のまま。
　手足の枷は不動のまま。
　そして<ruby>心鉄<rt>こころ</rt></ruby>は腐敗して、延々と腐敗し続けている。

en.html:
I had failed to protect him.

Kageaki, my master, was gone.
He and Chachamaru Ashikaga had shut me in this underground prison, then left for somewhere.

Of course I could not blame him for that treatment. Whose failure had allowed him to change like this? His tsurugi's. The very armor that was supposed to protect him.

Had my capabilities been sufficient, none of this would have been necessary. Such excellent armor, no? Only its own master it could not protect.

The restraints on my limbs were high-precision forged iron, the same material as armor plating. By strength I could not tear them apart. Some mechanism also obstructed the flow of heat; neither my abilities nor a change of form was possible.

Nothing remained but to hang my head like a doll its owner had tired of.

That much... I could accept. My own doing.

For a useless thing, a suitable arrangement. Even mockery I could supply myself.
But—

――守れなかった。

　<ruby>景明<rt>あるじ</rt></ruby>はいない。
　足利茶々丸と共に私をこの地下牢へ封じ込めると、
何処かへ去っていった。

　その仕打ちを責められないのは無論だった。
　景明を変貌させたのは、彼を守るべき劒冑の力不足
だったのだから。

　私に充分な性能があれば、こんな事にはならなくて
済んだ。

　手足を縛る拘束具は、高精度の鍛鉄製。
　甲鉄と同じ材質のそれは力で引き千切るなど不可能、
加えてどんな工夫によるものか熱量の流動を妨害する
ため、能力の行使も形態の変化も叶わなかった。

　飽きられた人形のようにこうして項垂れているほか、
私にできることは何もない。

　……それは、自業自得と諦めもつけられた。

　能無しには相応しい処遇と自嘲すらできる。
　だが、

en.html:
Him, I could not give up.

I had sworn to be his strength.
To him, and to myself, I had promised that his trust would be answered.

And when he needed me most? Useless. There I was, present and absolutely useless.

So my warrior's heart and soul were taken. That precious thing had fallen under the Silver Star's command and been terribly distorted.

'Straightforward,' that wretched Ashikaga had called it.
Not a lie, exactly. One part of Kageaki had been exaggerated; he had not been changed into something wholly different.

But things had been cut away.
Declared unnecessary. Thrown out.

His conflict.
He desired to save Hikaru Minato, and at the same time restrained himself: that was not permitted. Before he could find his own answer, that anguish had been swept away.

In one sense, it must have made things easier for him.
And who was I to speak as though somebody else's hands alone were dirty? I had once demanded that he abandon unnecessary suffering. Even tried to force him through Mental Pestilence. Haan, myself. That also I remembered.

But he refused. Another way, he wanted.
He and I—the warrior and his tsurugi—not one enslaved to the other. Respecting each other's will, fighting together. That was what he had asked of me.

I had not forgotten.
However many years remained to me, that I would never forget.

So I could not give up.
My own failure I could not forgive.

His will taken from him like this—no. This I could not accept.

...I had to go.
To Kageaki.

I had to go to him!!

ja.html:
彼のことだけは、諦めようがなかった。

　力になると誓ったのに。
　彼の信頼に応えることを、彼にも自分自身にも約束
したのに。

　私が最も必要であった瞬間に、私は無為無能だった
のだ。

　そうして仕手の心魂を奪われた。
　その貴重なものは銀星号の隷下に落ち、大きく歪め
られてしまっている。

　それを指して<ruby>素直<rt>・・</rt></ruby>などと言ったのは、忌々しい足利
某だが。
　確かに、嘘ではない――あれは景明の一部分を誇張
してはいても、全く別の何かに変えてはいないだろう。

　けれど、削ぎ落とされたものがある。
　不要として、捨てられてしまったものがある。

　彼の葛藤。
　湊斗光を助けたいと<ruby>欲する<rt>・・・</rt></ruby>一方、それは許されない
と<ruby>律する<rt>・・・</rt></ruby>彼の煩悶は、彼自身が答を出す前に消し飛ば
されてしまった。

　ある意味、それで彼は楽になったろう。
　他人事のように言えた話ではない――嘗ては私こそ
が彼に要らぬ苦悩を放棄するよう要求し、精神汚染を
もって強制しようとさえもしたのだ。

　しかし彼は拒み、別の形を望んだ。
　<ruby>仕手<rt>かれ</rt></ruby>と<ruby>劒冑<rt>わたし</rt></ruby>、どちらかがどちらかに隷従するのでは
なく――互いの意思を尊重して共闘しようと、求めて
くれたのだ。

　忘れていない。
　私の余命があと幾星霜あろうと、決して忘れないだ
ろう。

　だから諦められない。
　自分の失態が許せない。

　彼の意思がこんな形で奪われてしまったことを認め
られない。

　……行かなくては。
　景明のもとへ。

　私は行かなくてはならない!!

en.html:
Inside my heart I shouted all of it. Outside, the chains gave their answer.

I must go to Kageaki.
Clink.
He needs me.
Clink.
Arre, one other answer you have? No. Iron was very firm in its opinions. I should know.

How many times had we held this conversation now?

Nothing changed. The darkness did not even tremble. Coldly it kept me shut away. Only my heartsteel, my heart, repeated those useless cries and wounded itself each time. Slowly rotted.

Not like the long years asleep in the Minato house. Then I could be still. Now this stillness had become a terrible demand. Lie quietly, Muramasa. Do not want anything. You managed for centuries; suddenly what difficulty is coming?

Kageaki. That difficulty.

I had a master now.

Alone again—how could I remain alone now?

—I wanted to see him.

ja.html:
思いの丈を心に叫び、そして現実の鎖に屈服する。
　こんなことをもう幾度繰り返したのだろう。

　何も変わらない。
　闇は揺らぎもせず、私を冷徹に封じ込めている。

　ただ虚しい絶叫を繰り返す<ruby>心鉄<rt>こころ</rt></ruby>だけがその度に自ら
傷つき、徐々に腐ってゆく。

　以前、湊斗の家で永く眠っていたときとは違う。
　私はもう、あの頃のように静止してはいられない。

　私には<ruby>仕手<rt>あるじ</rt></ruby>がいるのだ。

　だからもう、独りではいられないのだ。

　――会いたい。

en.html:
Rotting.
Rotting.

The decay went on. My own destruction, without pity or pause. Not necessarily fast... but speed was hardly a kindness here.

No way out of this darkness. Sooner or later it would rot me through. Make me a heap of rust with no meaning left. Rust, at least, would not pretend it could protect anybody.

...But what right had I to hate that fate?

This tsurugi called Muramasa had already watched her warrior in peril, unable to do one thing.

Useless. Meaningless. A failed piece of work. My demonstration had been quite sufficient.

ja.html:
腐る。
　腐る。

　<ruby>腐敗<rt>じめつ</rt></ruby>は情けも容赦もなく進行する。
　必ずしも速くはない……だが同じことだ。

　この闇から脱する手がない以上、腐敗はいずれ私を
朽ち果てさせる。
　意味のない、錆の集まりにする。

　……しかし。
　それを厭う権利が、果たして私にあるのか。

　この村正なる劒冑は既に、為す術もなく仕手の窮地
を見送り、
　己が無意味な、益体もない駄作である事を証明して
しまっているのに。
